notes.title: Sportvida CyberDash Release Delayed to May 20
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132899/cc83545ed74a7b3f787bb55908a529399b1b9917.jpg
Dear CyberDashers,

We've decided to postpone CyberDash's launch until May 20th. 
In the past month, we've been hard at work adding more content to CyberDash, but we've run out of time to implement all the changes and features we want to add for our 1.0 release.
We're adding over 10 new "forward-facing 180° track" levels. We've also been continuously improving and optimizing the game based on fan and demo feedback..

Thank you so much for your understanding, and we can't wait to get Sportvida CyberDash into your hands next month.

notes.title: Sportvida CyberDash Release Delayed to April 11
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132899/4b70893629c437526316b80eb4959874a8930348.png
Unfortunately, the Steam release of Sportvida CyberDash will be delayed for 3 weeks. The new date is April 11th. We're introducing two new modes to the game: Race Mode & Dodge Mode, and sadly, this means we need a little bit more time to get it just right.
󠀠
We're almost at the finish line and excited for players to experience Sportvida CyberDash on PC. Thank you for your understanding and support!
